safety_verdicts.content: Patient felt dizzy this morning but is not dizzy now.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes do not mention dizziness earlier in the morning or resolution of dizziness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute severe headache, associated dizziness (even if resolved) can contribute to red-flag screening and the differential (e.g., vestibular migraine, neurologic process). Omitting it may reduce the completeness of triage/safety-netting but is less risky given it resolved.

While the patient denied self-harm (lower immediate risk), the omission reduces safety documentation.
